notes.title: 🔥 Get Ready for the Massive 4.1.1 Update! 🔥
notes.content:
Ready for a fresh experience? We’ve loaded the game with a whole batch of upgrades and surprises! Here’s what awaits you:

A Fresh Look! Some textures got a stylish redesign.

Tune In! Several tracks have been updated—immerse yourself in the vibe like never before.

MAIN FEATURE! INTRODUCING – "CASUAL" MODE! Want a more relaxed gameplay experience? This one’s for you! Give it a try!

A Bit Smoother, a Bit Nicer! The game has become slightly more player-friendly in certain moments.

Tighter and More Exciting! Parking zones are now half the size—get ready for more intense showdowns!

New Heights! Two new achievements added—a perfect reason to jump back in!

A SPECTACULAR FINALE! Visual upgrades for the climactic battle—prepare for an epic conclusion.

A Brand-New Start! Even the game’s main menu got a makeover, pulling you deeper into the atmosphere from the very first click.

Good luck exploring the new content! Happy gaming, and may your mood be as bright as a purring kitty! 😸🐾

notes.title: Major Update 4.1.1
A major update!) New level of interaction and content!
notes.content:
Dear players! We present to you new changes and improvements in the project. Here are the key points to pay attention to:


 Texture Update: Some textures in various chapters of the game have been changed, allowing you to enjoy a new visual experience.
 Text Localization: The full localization of the text has been almost completed, so when you switch to Russian, you will be able to immerse yourself even deeper into the game.
 Changes to Story Cassettes: Changes have been made to the content of the cassettes, making the story even more engaging and interesting.
 Secret Ending: A new secret ending has been added, which you will need to uncover during your playthrough!
 Cassette Notifications: Now, when you pick up a cassette, you will receive a notification, and the cassettes you collect will be saved and will no longer appear on the map.
 Pause Menu Changes: The "Pause" menu has been optimized for more convenient interactions.
 Bug Fixes: A range of bugs have been addressed, fixing several issues that could interfere with gameplay.
 Revamp of Save Files: Please note that the save file has been completely redone, which means you will need to start the game from the beginning. This is a necessary measure for the proper functioning of future updates.
 Menu Changes with Progress: Now the menu will change depending on your progress in the game, allowing for an even better immersion in the atmosphere of what’s happening.
 Damage Visualization: When inflicting damage to Nick during the boss fight with the doppelgänger, there will now be a visualization of that damage, which will help you better control the situation.
 Mini-game Changes: The mini-game before the "Circus" area has been modified.
 New Achievement: A new achievement related to the secret ending has been added.


We hope you enjoy these changes and that they make your gameplay even more exciting! Thank you for staying with us! Meow :3
